blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Filipino lawyers on Tuesday filed an appeal before the Court of Appeals, seeking to compel the Department of Justice (DOJ) to begin a preliminary investigation into war crimes committed by Myanmar junta leaders. Human rights lawyers Rommel Bagares and Gilbert Andres, representing at least five Chin nationals affected by human rights violations under the military junta, filed a petition for mandamus and certiorari before the appellate court to seek accountability from leader Min Aung Hlaing and other military officials. This follows their second motion asking the DOJ to resolve “without further delay” the complaint they filed in July, […]...
